title: Malice
author: John Gwynne
summary: A boy in a quiet village dreams of becoming a warrior as old powers stir and a war between ancient forces begins to return. This is the first of the Banished Lands books, a big, battle-heavy epic fantasy.
readIf: you like old-school epic fantasy with fighters, giants and a slow march toward war.
skipIf: you want something quiet or you dislike a lot of battle detail.

pairings.reason: A leisurely, classic epic fantasy that begins with a young person in a small corner of a huge world.
A darker and funnier fantasy with scarred soldiers and a bleaker view of heroes.
War told from the ground by soldiers, with a grim, practical outlook.
